# Quote — Library Analysis

An attributed quotation primitive: quote text + attribution (name / source) + optional
cite URL, in a standard blockquote or a larger pull-quote emphasis. Distinct from `Prose`,
which only styles a nested `<blockquote>` inside rendered markdown — `Quote` is a
composable, standalone component you pass content to.

### Quick Comparison

| | Mantine `Blockquote` | Chakra v3 `Blockquote` | shadcn/ui |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Props** | `cite`, `icon`, `color`, `iconSize`, `textWrap` | (Root) `variant`, `colorPalette`, `justify` | none — Tailwind classes |
| **Compound** | monolithic | compound (`Root`/`Content`/`Caption`/`Icon`) | none — raw `<blockquote>` |
| **Standout** | colored accent bar + optional quote icon + `cite` | composable testimonial cards; also a "closed" simple form | zero-API: `border-l-2 pl-6 italic` |

### Props Detail

#### Mantine — `Blockquote` (monolithic)
| Prop | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `cite` | `string` | — |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | — |
| `color` | theme color | theme primary |
| `iconSize` | `number` | — |
| `textWrap` | `'wrap' \| 'balance'` | — |

```tsx
<Blockquote cite="– Forrest Gump" icon={<IconInfoCircle />} color="blue">
  Life is like a box of chocolates…
</Blockquote>
```
Renders a semantic `<blockquote>` with a colored left accent bar; `cite` shown as inline caption.

#### Chakra v3 — `Blockquote` (compound)
| Prop (Root) | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `variant` | `'subtle' \| 'solid' \| 'plain'` | `subtle` |
| `colorPalette` | color token | `gray` |
| `justify` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | `start` |

```tsx
<Blockquote.Root>
  <Blockquote.Content cite="https://…">Quote text</Blockquote.Content>
  <Blockquote.Caption>— Author, Source</Blockquote.Caption>
</Blockquote.Root>
```
Attribution is a first-class `Caption` slot; composes with `Avatar`/`Float` for testimonials.

#### shadcn/ui — typography pattern (no component)
```tsx
<blockquote className="mt-6 border-l-2 pl-6 italic">Quote</blockquote>
```
No attribution slot, no `cite` — you compose it yourself. (MUI likewise ships no dedicated
Blockquote; you style `Typography` — not researched further.)

### Recommendations for Move

1. **Components to build:** ONE monolithic `Quote` in `typography/`. Its siblings — `Text`,
   `Heading`, `Code`, `Prose` — are all monolithic; a compound `Quote.Root/Content/Caption`
   (Chakra) would break that consistency for a primitive this small. Take Chakra's *idea*
   (a first-class attribution slot) as a **prop**, not sub-components.

2. **Props consensus + proposed Move shape:**
   | Prop | Type | Notes |
   |------|------|-------|
   | `children` | `ReactNode` | the quote text (required) |
   | `attribution?` | `ReactNode` | rendered in `<figcaption>` — name + optional source (e.g. `Claude, Opus 4.8`) |
   | `cite?` | `string` | source URL → the `<blockquote cite>` HTML attribute |
   | `variant?` | `'block' \| 'pull'` | standard indented blockquote vs larger pull-quote emphasis — **NB: meaningful names, not `'default'`** |
   | `icon?` | `string` | optional decorative quote-mark, resolved via `useResolvedIcon` (no inline svg), `aria-hidden` |
   | `color?` | `Color` | optional accent for the rule/border (Move categorical color); default neutral |

3. **Composition / semantics (the real value):** render
   `<figure><blockquote cite={cite}>{children}</blockquote><figcaption>{attribution}</figcaption></figure>`
   when `attribution` is present; a bare `<blockquote>` when not. Attribution lives in
   `<figcaption>` **outside** the `<blockquote>` — per the HTML spec the attribution is not
   part of the quoted text. This semantic correctness is exactly what a primitive should carry
   so the consumer can't get it wrong.

4. **Animation:** none. Static typography.

5. **Component class:** static/display typography — a semantic-structure contract only
   (correct `figure`/`blockquote`/`figcaption` + `cite`), no interaction, state, or animation.
   Confirm the exact class enum in `/component-create-spec`.

6. **Default candidates (not decisions):**
   - `variant`: `'block'` — high confidence
   - `icon`: none — medium
   - `color`: neutral rule, no accent — medium
   - `block` sizing: base/`lg` quote text, muted `sm` attribution, left rule; **not italic by default** (Move-native, avoid shadcn's italic) — medium
   - `pull` sizing: `xl`/`2xl` quote text, centered or hung — medium

7. **Key decisions (need user input before the spec):**
   a. Monolithic (recommended) vs compound `Quote.Root/Content/Attribution`.
   b. Attribution as a single flexible `attribution?: ReactNode` (recommended) vs structured `author`/`source` props.
   c. Include the accent `color` prop (Mantine/Chakra do) or keep strictly neutral?
   d. Default decorative quote-mark icon: none (recommended) vs a subtle glyph.
   e. Ship both `block` + `pull` in v1, or `block` only and add `pull` when a second consumer needs it?
